Er_Rin_estimation._comment: Vss is estimated as median of raw Vm over the first Vss_duration_seconds; Vss_* fields (bin_width, smooth_sigma, Im_scale) are vestigial from the older weighted-mode estimator but still required by the schema. max_residual_volts is the residual threshold for the Vss-based drift clustering: a candidate K is accepted iff every (paradigm, clamp) in every cluster has |Vss_observed - Vss_hat_OLS(Iinj)| <= max_residual_volts. Smaller K is preferred; K=N is always feasible.

Ee_Ei_estimation._comment: Quantile-based (Ee, Ei) estimator with physiological difference constraint. low/high_quantile pick Ei/Ee from pooled Eeff(t). The difference Ee-Ei is then clipped to [dE_min, dE_max] by symmetric adjustment (preserving midpoint). Rationale: recordings have uncontrolled voltage offsets, so absolute reversals are not recoverable; only the offset-invariant difference is well determined. Defaults: dE_min = 55 mV (typical Ee=-10, Ei=-65 limit) and dE_max = 120 mV (Ee=+10, Ei=-110 limit).
